claim: A pace debt kept through a menu with nothing to repay it makes the first updates of play run fast; cap the debt at one frame, clear it at the screen clear, and count at every nested hook's close.

evidence.text: The ISR hook's cost every frame with no delay to repay it made the first 25 updates run 15% fast. A window counted only from the ISR hook loses a frame when an interrupt lands in a ROM trampoline.
